keys shadow-root modal fixture

Three modal dialogs, each holding a field and a slotted M button: one in the document, one in x-modal's open shadow root, and one in the x-modal inside x-nest's own, two shadow roots deep. While any is open, only its M fires: not T, /, or ?, which opens help. Escape in its field leaves the field to the dialog, which closes.
